notes.title: ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree joins Untold Tales
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Three years ago, we launched our first ever title as a studio with [b]ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree[/b]. It was received with critical acclaim and won several awards, and we were so humbled by all the support and love for the unique Norse world we created.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/4005a0aa7ce0f645ef6de4804fc79f41f34448ac.png[/img]

Now, we have several announcements to share with you all! 

[h1]New Publisher[/h1]
First up, we're happy to share that we have an official publisher: [b]Untold Tales[/b]! They've been a great partner and will support us in all efforts to bring our game to you as smoothly as possible. So go on and give them a follow! -> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/untoldtales][/url]

[h1]Release Window[/h1]
Second, we're excited to confirm that we're targeting launch in [b]early 2023[/b]. We understand that it's not an exact date, but game development can fluctuate wildly and we don't want to promise something only to disappoint! AND, we'll also be launching on Nintendo Switch, so you can find us there if that's more your style.

[h1]Next Fest Demo Available Now[/h1]
Last but certainly not least, we have a free demo for you to try as part of Next Fest! That's right, it's available now. So keep that axe sharp, you'll need it! And when you're done playing, come back and give us your thoughts. We'd love to hear them!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620

If you enjoyed what you played, please wishlist and spread the word, as that helps immensely to increase awareness. Be sure to follow our social channels below for all news and future updates on ATONE.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/untoldtalesgames
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@untoldtaleshq

[i]Cheers!
Wildboy Studios and Untold Tales[/i]

notes.title: Welcoming Three New Titles to Untold Tales!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/23e3d546cdfad2dc822f6efc50a954a42856a0a5.png[/img]

Our collection of story-loving games continues to grow. We are excited to share that we've added three additional titles to the Untold Tales portfolio with Mythic Ocean, Lifeslide, and Dr Livingstone, I Presume?!

https://youtu.be/dYh9dC0CAJ4

If you could decide the evolutionary fate of the entire ocean, what choices would you make? Mythic Ocean is a narrative exploration about meeting the gods who rule beneath the waves and guiding (or misguiding) them in their choices.  An engaging choice driven game with multiple outcomes, an open-world feel and relaxed pace. Every interaction you make with a character changes the course of the world and story and the , so choose wisely. Or entertainingly. In fact, try both, since this story has tons of replayability.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/814360

In Dr Livingstone, I Presume? A Reversed Escape Room, the world-renowned 19th Century explorer Dr David Livingston has sent you - his most trusted friend - a cryptic message. Something is wrong but the details are scare. It’s now up to you to venture to his mysterious and eccentric mansion to uncover the truth of what has happened. Solve a mix of intricate and diverse puzzles as you venture deeper and deeper into the rooms of the mansion. Along the way, uncover historical facts and story built around real events and people but with a few creative twists.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1237510

Lifeslide is a relaxing but also challenging adventure about guiding your paper airplane through a wonderous world of sights and obstacles. Simple controls but intricate physics mean you’ll need to master the art of gathering and preserve your momentum, using the terrain to your advantage and reacting in time. All around you in the world is the story of life, and the journey we all take through it.  Additional competitive and zen modes mean there is a way for everyone.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/956140

Wishlisting and following these really helps us and the developers out!

Be sure to drop us a comment below if you've played any of the titles listed above.

---
Team Untold Tales

notes.title: October Update is Out!
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for playing Lifeslide and being part of the community! Before we start, if you have been following the game but you don't have it yet, Lifeslide is 30% off until November 1st so now is a great time to jump aboard:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/956140/Lifeslide/

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
This month's update comes a bit late but there is a good reason for that. We have added a bunch of new content and features. And without further ado:

[h3]New Level Content[/h3]
We have extended some of the levels with additional segments meaning that there are now new places to explore! The extended levels are Loving, Giving and Softening.
                       [img]https://media.giphy.com/media/kuoaMUyfMVvXF4zdJT/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]New Hidden Skins To Unlock[/h3]
The appearances department was a bit lacking so we have been working to create some good looking skins that you can unlock. Explore hidden areas to unlock the new appearances. Most of them are visible in the Appearances menu and have hints. There are also three secret skins. We won't tell you where they are. 
                                                   [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/4e84a12ae49523b1c9e21cb4aca31ab634cbc9cb.gif[/img]

[h3]Speedrun Mode[/h3]
New Speedrun mode has been added for those of you who like to race against the clock. Supported modes are New Game and New Game +. Leaderboards hold the best results - the competition is on! You can find Speedrun Mode in Main Menu / Compete

[h3]Halloween Fest Event Ready to Start[/h3]
The Halloween Fest event starts on October 31st and ends on November 7th. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/956140/view/4821658732172976231]Learn more here.[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/c1c11385ee9b95dcca79fd1fdc7bb521e6dd9e41.png[/img]

[h3]Other Changes & Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The weekly challenge updates - maps are a bit shorter, players receive damage from environment, values are balanced
[*] The green plane stats have been tweaked
[*] Fixed tiny gaps between segments on some levels
[*] Fixed gaps between segments on some levels
[*] Fixed the challenge countdown timer sound not being affected by the SFX slider
[*] Fixed the bug where players can start the game with a Will power-up
[*] Paper skins now look sharper in-game
[/list]

That's it for October's update we hope you have fun exploring the new content and now it's time for:

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
We'll skip November but we are already working on more content for a December update. You can expect a very special Christmas event, more level extensions, more appearances and possibly modding support.

notes.title: September Update is Out!
notes.content:
[h1]Lifeslide September Update is Live![/h1]
Thank you for playing this weird little game! It means a lot to us.
Our team has been working hard to improve the Lifeslide experience and patch any holes in the hull along the way. Now, without further ado, let's dig into what's new:

[h3]Player Ghosts[/h3]
[previewyoutube=1S3EYUBbvAI;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
We are working to expand and improve the [b]weekly challenges[/b]. This is why you can now see the players above you in the leaderboards right next to you while flying. There is a setting for how many player ghosts you like to see inside the options menu. Player ghosts can also be turned off from the options menu. Check out this video to see how this looks in-game.

[h3]Save File Management[/h3]
One of the more common questions we've been getting in our community is how to delete save files. Worry not, we got you! You can now create up to three save files and delete existing ones. Find the Manage Saves screen in [b]Options/Game/Manage Saves[/b] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/ee470bd70548d5071be51e9568aca1722593e450.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/77c4774f1e9c25c180b25c447e61a2cdbfb35eec.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Flight Stick & Generic Controller Support [/h3]
We have added support for flight sticks and generic controllers. Lifeslide is now playable with HOTAS controllers, racing wheels (yes, not recommended) and generic controllers. For some specific generic controllers, the UI might not be navigatable but the input can be set up in the Bindings screen of the controls options. 

[h3]Reset Tutorials Button[/h3]
If you need to reset the tutorials but don't want to start a new game, you can now do that in Options/Game/Reset Tutorials

[h3]Bulgarian Localization[/h3]
We're a Bulgarian studio so we've added Bulgarian language to the game and Steam store page. Наздраве!

[h3]Smaller Fixes and Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game start screen added right after the intro
[*] UI is now more responsive and can be navigated faster
[*] Fixed issues with missing Russian, Chinese, Japanese and Korean font glyphs
[*] Better camera behavior when flying close to ceilings
[*] Better countdown and launch sequence for the weekly challenges
[*] Plane selection for weekly challenges now shows the player rank for each plane
[*] Added burning sounds when the player is... well, burning
[*] Various small tweaks and fixes in the UI and UX
[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
This is it for the September update but we're working on more features and content for October. Halloween is upon us and we're preparing something quite special. You can expect more level content and more skins.

We do our best to address all issues mentioned on Discord and in the Steam discussions. 
Got any feature requests or bug reports? Get in touch!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/956140/discussions/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/956140/discussions/[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/bkYDq8v]https://discord.gg/bkYDq8v[/url]

notes.title: Lifeslide September BETA is Out
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone and thank you for an exciting August! [/h1]
It has been exactly a month since Lifeslide was released here on Steam. During that time we have been working on new content and features because we want to keep expanding and improving the Lifeslide experience. 

[h2]Lifeslide September BETA is Out[/h2]
Content updates are coming soon but until then we would like to introduce some new features in the game. The feature in question is player ghosts in the weekly challenges. You will now be able to see how other players have played through the challenge. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/89681eb52ff207c38bf27212fb1fd573cd8d57d6.png[/img]

The feature is still experimental and so we're looking to gather some feedback as well as stress test it. For those of you who would like to help testing this, we would really appreciate it if you jumped on the BETA branch and played some weekly challenges. 

Other changes in the BETA branch so far:
[list]
[*] Better countdown and launch sequence for the challenges
[*] Better camera behavior when flying close to ceilings
[*] The UI and navigation is now more responsive to allow for faster retries
[*] Improved point collection effect to give a better understanding of where the points are coming from
[/list]

More coming soon!

[h2]How to get Lifeslide BETA?[/h2]
To get the Lifeslide BETA version with all the latest features and additions, right click Lifeslide in your Library, then choose Properties, navigate to the BETAS tab and from the dropdown menu select "beta":

Or you can join our Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/bkYDq8v]here[/url]

Thank you for helping us bring new things to the table!

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.content:
Okay, yes, more like day 3 patch but better late than never, right? Oh, no, "Never" is not something you'll get in regards to Lifeslide update - that's a promise!

First of all, thank you all so much for the amazing feedback and support throughout the launch days! Our team is humbled by the positive reception and we want to keep delivering new things to keep everyone smile! 

[h1]Change log[/h1]
Throughout the launch, we spotted a bunch of issues that we wanted to fix right away and so here we go:

[h3]Fixed unloading sky textures [/h3]
We're so sorry to let this slip upon release. This glitch was caused by looping through the entire game or going to the main menu and returning to the game. It was not game breaking but it was very ugly. The sky is now here to stay!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/327ff3917f4c5116902d9713590cdc78e8110822.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/4553930f074c4801d2b92b6924088fe5e04472c8.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Fixed the In Love achievement[/h3]
The In Love achievement rewards you for passing the "Loving" level without collecting a single Integrity or Matter gem. Or at least it was supposed to. We found out that the achievement was being rewarded to everyone regardless. This is now fixed and now you gotta work for it! 

[h3]Fixed Zen Crash[/h3]
There was a critical issue with one of the levels in Zen mode where it caused the entire game mode to stop working. We have patched it. Zen is now stable! 


[h3]Small fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the description of one of the plane's skins
[*] Fixed some spawn points on Story that were sketchy
[*] Fixed plane selection rendering the paper planes gray-ish
[*] Fixed some animations in the "Creating" level. Giant falling blocks from the sky are no joke!
[*] Tweaked the mountain ridge before the ending so that it doesn't cause halts
[*] Reduced the long delay after the ending sequence
[*] Fixed a graphical glitch where a black thing was flashing on screen every once in a while
[/list]

Well, that's it for now.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We are in dire need of a break and will take this week off to regenerate. We'll be keeping an eye on the community during the break.

After that, well, we have plans for some CONTENT AND FEATURE UDPATES! Yes, new level content, more plane appearances, new music, UI/UX improvements and more is coming in about a month and a half! Stay tuned for this! 

[h1]And after that?[/h1]
Did you know we have multiplayer racing in the works? Yes! If the game does well, we will be able to further develop it:
[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/indiegames/comments/jp1fgm/introducing_online_racing_in_lifeslide/]MULTIPLAYER FOOTAGE[/url]

If you haven't yet joined the Discord community - that's the best place to give feedback and discuss the future of Lifeslide: [url=]https://discord.gg/bkYDq8v [/url]

notes.title: Lifeslide (PC) Mini Review
notes.content:
[img]https://www.cgmagonline.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/news-lifeslide-pc-mini-review.jpg[/img]

While the flight simulator genre has always been one of the better original concepts from the early days of PC gaming, there has been a recent resurgence, headlined by Microsoft Flight Simulator returning for a 2020 edition. While Lifeslide isn’t purely a flight simulator, it takes the control schemes and traversal from such titles and has the player controlling one of the most durable paper airplanes I’ve ever seen in my entire life. While the Zen-like experience features beautiful visuals and a soundtrack built for relaxation, the length of the game and shallow game mechanics make this more of a pleasant afternoon than something you’ll spend hours exploring.

While there isn’t a story to explain why this seemingly sentient paper plane is flying across the wilderness, Lifeslide leans into its arcade experience, with gameplay taking center stage. Using basic flight sim controls, you will manipulate your plane against the currents and around obstacles to continue your journey ever forward. From snowy regions to dense forests and more, you’ll be checking out diverse areas, but beyond a few abilities than allow for different speed boosts or access down alternate paths, you’re just flying forward while slightly adjusting direction.

Flight can be maintained by keeping from running into things, while also keeping a close eye on the timer ticking away. Gathering streams of yellow pixels adds to your time allowance, furthering forward progress, so prioritizing paths through each level will be based on your needs. The other collectibles available are blue pixel streams, which can be gathered and spent on upgrades for your paper airplane. Additionally, ability markers can be flown into which allow for speed boosts forwards and upwards, while other markers allow for access through doors or give airplane parts to unlock additional “models” of planes.

“…there just isn’t enough reason to come back to after the initial completion.”

Having such a rudimentary concept allows you to sit back and relax, which seems to be the point of the game alongside it’s purely Zen soundtrack but paired with the fact that the game can be completed in around an hour if you’re at all decent at flight sims, there just isn’t enough here to really make it a must-play title. While the PC version adds additional levels to fly through, alongside an endless Zen mode and multiplayer racing mode, there just isn’t enough reason to come back to after the initial completion.

Lifeslide really shines in its visuals, with low-poly, colorful environments that tell a story all their own. Soaring between giant trees or through ancient ruins makes for an enticing experience, only amplified by the aforementioned soundtrack. Swapping through areas happens very quickly, as the 20+ stages on offer take you through some of the most diverse environments you’ll find, but lacking any real challenge and keeping to simplicity makes this the walking simulator of flight sims. That isn’t meant to say that it’s bad, just that that’s more of the experience felt rather than dealing with complicated flight mechanics.

“Lifeslide tells a story without saying anything.”

Lifeslide tells a story without saying anything. Its beautifully crafted environments and Zen-like soundtrack keep you relaxed through the entire experience. Unfortunately, that experience is quite short, and the rudimentary mechanics keep the focus on the experience rather than challenging the player. A pleasant afternoon, but not something you’ll ultimately spend much time with.
